call_points.text: High single-digit volume growth for FY27 maintained, with volumes expected to pick up significantly in Q3 and Q4.
Coal tar distillation project definition progressing; capex approval and firm dates expected within a month or two.
Domestic carbon black volume rose 15% YoY to 102,985 tonnes; international was 50,528 tonnes after deliberate diversion to domestic spot.
Q2 volumes may be temporarily hit as customers adopt cautious procurement and destock; management calls it timing, not demand.
Freight remains high and erratic; surcharges recover most but not all of the cost, varying by customer.
Nanovace pilot plant is up; first batch of customer samples targeted in the coming weeks of August.
Management expects high single-digit carbon black volume growth and double-digit EBITDA growth in FY27.
Aquapharm expected to deliver 20-25% top-line growth in FY27.
Cost initiatives across yield, throughput, and feedstock diversification on track to unlock ₹200-250 Cr savings over 4-6 quarters.
Added 90,000 MT carbon black capacity in Tamil Nadu, taking total installed capacity to 880,000 MTPA.
Mudra 20,000 MT specialty black line ready for commissioning in coming weeks; Palej 1,000 MTPA line delayed due to gas shortage.
Net borrowings reduced by ₹454 Cr to ₹4,536 Cr in FY26 while funding ₹750 Cr capex.
West Asia conflict added 14 days transit time via Cape of Good Hope, raising freight and raw material costs.
Carbon black EBITDA per ton for FY26 stood at ₹14,939 per ton.
Net cash generated from operating activities rose to ₹1,576 Cr in FY26 compared to ₹760 Cr in FY25.

operating_notes.text: Carbon black EBITDA per ton for FY26 stood at ₹14,939 per ton.
FY26 total carbon black sales volume reached 6,18,956 MT.
Total installed carbon black capacity stands at 880,000 MTPA post 90,000 MT expansion in Tamil Nadu.
Cost reduction initiatives target ₹200-250 Cr of savings over next 4-6 quarters.
PCBL Chemical fully deployed ₹448 Cr proceeds from 1.60 Cr warrants issued at ₹280 across debt repayment, working capital, and GCP by 31 March 2026.
Carbon black sales volume was 153,513 tonnes in Q1FY27, with tires at 91,379 tonnes, performance chemicals at 42,386 tonnes and specialty at 19,748 tonnes, up 23% YoY.
Power generation was 217 million units with external sales of 130 million units in Q1FY27 at realisation of ₹5.39 a unit versus ₹3.66 in Q4FY26.
Brent averaged USD 97 per barrel in Q1FY27 versus USD 78 in Q4FY26, and the CBFS-CBO price gap stayed close to USD 150 with CBO higher.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,066.06 Cr (-1.0% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹40.25 Cr (-59.8% YoY).
PCBL released its Q4FY26 investor update highlighting FY26 revenue of ₹8,190 Cr, EBITDA of ₹1,081 Cr, and ₹1,000 Cr debt reduction.
PCBL Chemical Limited’s **K. Mukherjee** shared the Q4 FY26 results conference call audio link on 30 April 2026 at 14:30 IST via www.pcblltd.com/investor-relation/financials/investor-presentation.
PCBL Chemical held its Q4FY26 earnings call, guiding to double-digit EBITDA growth and high single-digit carbon black volume growth in FY27.
PCBL Chemical Limited’s shareholders approved Ms. Sneh Lata (DIN: 11628402) as Non-Executive Independent Woman Director via remote e-voting on May 8, 2026, with 94.21% favor.
PCBL Chemical submitted its final Monitoring Agency Report confirming utilisation of ₹448 Cr preferential warrant proceeds.
Rainbow Investments Limited disclosed holding 186,630,740 PCBL Chemical Limited shares as of March 31, 2026, with no encumbrances.
Saregama India Limited, via Nayan Misra, declared no encumbrance on PCBL Chemical Limited shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2025-26 on 31 March 2026.

On its 29 July 2026 Q1FY27 call, PCBL reported revenue up 17% to ₹2,474 Cr and PAT up 65% to ₹155 Cr, flagged ₹40-50 Cr of inventory gain to reverse, and kept FY27 EBITDA per tonne guidance at ₹16,500-17,000.
